latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video AI — Convert Images Into Video Clips.

- Instantly turn up to three JPG product images into 1080p animated video clips with simple text instructions.
- No setup required: auto-connects to cloud GPU backend, handles authentication for free (limited credits included).
- Supports batch uploads, text overlays, background music, and aspect ratio changes through concise prompts.
- Exports high-quality MP4 (plus other major formats), delivered in 30–90 seconds with easy download links.
- Clear error messages, session continuity, and status feedback for a smooth user experience.
